name: super-el-nino-simulator
description: Super El Nino Global Impact Simulator - an interactive R3F globe with a client-side DuckDB-WASM analytics engine.

scripts.//build:e2e: Node wrapper, not `VITE_E2E=1 vite build`: pnpm runs scripts through cmd.exe on Windows, where that POSIX assignment is parsed as a command name and fails, so the E2E bundle was never actually built there.
scripts.build:e2e: node scripts/copy-duckdb.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/build-e2e.mjs && node scripts/check-assets.mjs --allow-e2e
scripts.//e2e: Targeted subset: `pnpm e2e -- --grep globe`. PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never keeps CI from blocking on the report.
scripts.//e2e:look: Look acceptance suite: the look specs (3.1-3.7 incl. the negative tests) plus globe.spec.ts's five zoom cases. cross-env because pnpm runs scripts through cmd.exe on Windows, where a bare VAR=val prefix is parsed as a command name.
scripts.e2e:look: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never playwright test tests/e2e/look.spec.ts tests/e2e/negative.spec.ts tests/e2e/globe.spec.ts
